name: AWARE 2.0 — Phase 3 AZR Self-Play on Modal (training-optimizer 4-bit QLoRA DPO + trainer poller)
author: Alfie <alfie@localhost>
goal: Close the AWARE 2.0 learning loop. The trainer service watches for new preference pairs in Postgres, submits DPO fine-tuning jobs to Modal (A100-80GB + training-optimizer 4-bit QLoRA on Qwen 2.5 7B), polls for completion, and atomically swaps the active weight checkpoint. Phase 3 produces the first self-improving model. Architecture decisions: A1 (single source of truth = Postgres-aware_conversations), B3 (env-var kill switch, default off), C2 (token read from canonical credential store, NEVER in repo).
preconditions: Branch: feature/aware-2.0 (clean working tree at 0214789 or later)
Phase 2.1 conversation logger shipped — src/db/logger.js writes to aware_conversations
Phase 2.2 PRM score cache shipped — src/db/prm-cache.js, aware_prm_cache table
Phase 2.3 budget watchdog shipped — aware_budget_windows migration + src/budget/watchdog.js

architecture_decisions.dataset_source: A1 (Postgres aggregate on aware_conversations; pairs are produced by heavy-think's toDpoDataset and tracked in conversations.cost_total_usd)
architecture_decisions.kill_semantics: B3 (env-var kill switch AWARE_TRAINER_ENABLED=0 default; re-read on every poll tick, no caching)
architecture_decisions.credential_location: C2 (Modal token read from process.env.<redacted-credential-name>/SECRET at runtime; never in repo, image, or compose file; canonical credential store = <credential-store>/credentials.env)
architecture_decisions.training_runtime: D1 (training-optimizer 4-bit QLoRA on Qwen 2.5 7B base, single A100-80GB on Modal, 60 GPU hours per run ≈ $150)
architecture_decisions.checkpoint_swap: E1 (atomic symlink: create tmp symlink, then rename(2) over the active symlink; survives concurrent readers)

config_shape.enabled: AWARE_TRAINER_ENABLED (default false; off = trainer is dormant, no polling, no job submission)
config_shape.minPairsPerRun: AWARE_TRAINER_MIN_PAIRS_PER_RUN (default 100; below this the trainer accumulates and waits)
config_shape.weightsDir: AWARE_TRAINER_WEIGHTS_DIR (default /root/aware-weights; the symlink that the coordinator would read to load the active model)
config_shape.modalTokenId: <redacted-credential-name> (read from env; never logged; redacted in snapshot())
config_shape.modalTokenSecret: <redacted-credential-name> (read from env; never logged; redacted in snapshot())

deliverables.azr_executor: azr/executor.py — sandboxed Python verifier for the AZR self-play loop. Hard sandbox: subprocess isolation, filesystem chroot, stripped builtins (no open/exec/eval/__import__), wrapped __import__ to block forbidden modules, POSIX rlimits (CPU, memory, file size, nproc, nofile). 32 unit tests in test/unit/azr/test_executor.py (31 pass, 1 Linux-only memory test skipped on macOS). NO Modal access required — runs anywhere Python 3.10+ is available.
deliverables.dockerfile_training: Dockerfile.training — CUDA 12.4 base, Python 3.10 venv, pinned ML deps from training/requirements-training.txt (training-optimizer 2024.10.7, TRL 0.11.4, peft 0.13.2, bitsandbytes 0.44.1, torch 2.4.1, modal 0.64.0). NO token in image layers. /opt/aware WORKDIR. ENTRYPOINT python3 -m training.run.
deliverables.modal_training_config: config/modal-training.json + config/modal-training.schema.json — declarative spec for the Modal app. App name, image, GPU type, volume mount, DPO defaults, checkpoint paths, self-play corpus size, metrics, failure policy. Schema validates: jsonschema passes for good config, rejects missing required / invalid GPU type / out-of-range beta.
deliverables.training_run_py: training/run.py — DPO training job entry point that runs INSIDE the Modal container. CLI: --config, --dataset, --output-dir, --run-id, --gen-azr-corpus, --azr-corpus-size, --smoke-test. Lazy imports for transformers/unsloth so CLI works without GPU. AZR self-play proposer/solver/test-extractor inlined. Emits JSON-line progress to stdout, parsed by the trainer service. Exit codes: 0=ok, 1=generic, 2=config, 3=dataset, 4=model load, 5=training OOM, 6=checkpoint save.
deliverables.trainer_poller: src/trainer/index.js — Node-based aware-trainer service. Polls Postgres for new preference pairs, submits Modal jobs, polls for completion, downloads checkpoint, atomic symlink swap. Kill switch re-read on every tick. Token never logged, never serialized. 14 unit tests in test/unit/trainer/index.test.js (DI'd modal client + pg pool, drives _tick() deterministically).
deliverables.training_runs_migration: db/migrations/004_training_runs.sql — aware_training_runs table (run_id, status, n_pairs, modal_job_id, base_model, hyperparameters, duration, cost, checkpoint_dir, exit_code, error_message). Partial index on status='running' for fast polling. Authoritative record of what runs have happened and their state.
deliverables.compose_trainer_service: docker-compose.coordinator.yml — 8th service 'trainer' behind the `training` profile. AWARE_TRAINER_ENABLED=0 default. env_file <credential-store-file> with required:false. Modal token never in compose. New volume: aware-2-trainer-data.
deliverables.bring_up_smoke_tests: scripts/bring-up-coordinator.sh — +3 smoke tests for Phase 3: (a) aware_training_runs table exists (migration 004 applied), (b) modal-training.json has all required fields, (c) trainer container boot log present (when --profile training is enabled).

verification.code_level: 208/208 Node tests + 31/32 Python tests (1 Linux-only skip) + 13 bring-up smoke tests + 3 new Phase 3 smoke tests. The trainer service is fully implemented and tested via DI'd dependencies. No Modal access required for any test.
verification.runtime_level: To actually run a DPO training job: (1) provision Modal account, (2) set <redacted-credential-name> + <redacted-credential-name> in <credential-store-file>, (3) set AWARE_TRAINER_ENABLED=1 in the trainer service's compose env, (4) bring up with --profile training, (5) wait for AWARE_TRAINER_MIN_PAIRS_PER_RUN (default 100) preference pairs to accumulate, (6) trainer submits the first job. Runtime cost: ~$150 per training run on A100-80GB, ~$3K total Modal budget per ADR-020.

secrets_handling: Modal token is the only new credential. It is read at trainer boot from process.env.<redacted-credential-name> / <redacted-credential-name> (set by the operator's <credential-store-file> on the host, never in the repo). The token is NEVER logged, NEVER serialized, NEVER included in compose YAML. config.snapshot() redacts both fields as '<redacted length=N>'. Standing memory rule: 'Credential location, not value' is honored — I write process.env references, the operator sets the value.
out_of_scope: Phase 4 — Training Pipeline Integration (training data filter + combined DPO + eval). Depends on Phase 3 having a real trained model.
Phase 5 — N.O.M.A.D. portability (install.sh, .env.example full template, Redis memory service, T0-T4 enforcement on workers). Independent of Phase 3.

Real Modal SDK implementation in src/trainer/index.js — the default constructor uses a stub that throws on submit, the production version would import 'modal' and use modal.Function.from_id(jobId).remote(). The seam is in place (deps.modalClient); the SDK call sites are stubbed. Implementing them is a 30-line change once the SDK is in package.json.

Outbound dataset packaging — the trainer currently writes a placeholder JSONL to datasetPath. The real implementation queries aware_conversations for unconsumed pairs, runs heavy-think's toDpoDataset, and writes the result. Seamed via the _submitNewRun method; not implemented because Phase 4 owns the outcome filter.
Postgres migration auto-apply — the coordinator's runMigrations() reads db/migrations/*.sql in order. The new 004 file will be picked up on next coordinator boot. Verified by the bring-up smoke test.

r2_revisions.summary: modal-client.js rewritten to use real JS SDK surface (modal@0.8.0); the R1 mock with the Python-shaped API was a real bug that would have crashed the first submit() against the real SDK.
changes: src/trainer/modal-client.js: replaced modal.Function.from_training_script() with new ModalClient() + client.functions.fromName(app, fn) + fn.spawn() + call.get({timeoutMs})
test/unit/trainer/modal-client.test.js: mocks now use REAL JS SDK method shapes (ModalClient class with .volumes.fromName + .functions.fromName)
scripts/bring-up-coordinator.sh: added 8e smoke that uses the REAL modal@0.8.0 SDK and asserts the surface the poller depends on (catches R1 regression)
test/unit/config/index.test.js: clearV2Env() now also clears <redacted-credential-name> and <redacted-credential-name> (hermetic against host env leakage)
r2_revisions.operator_action: Run `modal deploy training/run.py` ONCE before the first training job. No GPU credit, no spin-up. Just registers the App. Use `MODAL_PROFILE=goodciso modal deploy training/run.py` (or `modal deploy --profile goodciso training/run.py`) so Modal uses the `goodciso` CLI profile that already holds the token in ~/.modal.toml. The profile name is purely operator-side CLI shorthand for the (token_id, token_secret) pair; the poller reads the values from process.env, not the profile name, so the profile name does NOT need to be in the code or any committed file.
r2_revisions.verification: 13/13 modal-client tests + 221/221 v2 tests + bring-up 8d + 8e smokes all green. Real modal@0.8.0 SDK installed and surface verified.
